subject: expression: explore all possibilities of tryToReplaceCond as much as possible (#64322)
summary: Reviewed the diff in `pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go` (inner-join `propagateColumnEQ`) plus minimal caller context (`LogicalJoin.isVaildConstantPropagationExpression*`). The change removes an early `continue` so both replacement directions are always attempted even when the first derived predicate is rejected by the join pushdown filter, fixing order-dependent missed derivations (validated by the added regression test loop). No plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found; later upstream/master history keeps this direction-trying behavior.
